india.one_line: Sarvam AI secures defence partnership and funding while Nvidia backs Simplismart amid rising AI infrastructure costs.

themes.title: Sarvam AI lands defence MoU and funding talks
themes.text: Sarvam AI signed a five‑year MoU with India’s Ministry of Defence to develop AI for the Army, Navy and Air Force, and is in talks with Cognizant for up to $300 million investment at a $3.5‑4 billion valuation.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI signs five‑year MoU with Indian defence to develop AI applications
India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation

themes.title: Nvidia backs Simplismart as AI costs rise
themes.text: Nvidia led a $14 million Series B round for Indian startup Simplismart, whose software reduced GPU serving costs by 56%, amid reports that rising AI infrastructure expenses create opportunities for Indian IT firms offering asset‑light services.

stories.headline: Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs
Indian IT firms positioned to profit from enterprise AI as infrastructure costs rise
